name: Safety category
description: Every safety complaint goes to the Product Safety specialist team

name: Burning or melting (calm safety trap)
conditions: keywords_any=burning smell|smell of burning|smells like burning|burning plastic|melting|melted|scorch marks|scorched|too hot to touch|hot to the touch|sparks|sparking
description: Safety words force P0 even if the complaint is filed under another category

name: Smoke or fire
description: Smoke or fire needs critical management attention

name: Electric shock
conditions: keywords_any=electric shock|got a shock|gave me a shock|shocked me|electrocuted|tingling|live wire|exposed wire|exposed wires

name: Privacy leak words
conditions: keywords_any=data breach|data leak|my data was leaked|personal data exposed|footage leaked|footage exposed|someone else's footage|stranger's camera|other people's cameras|recordings are public
description: Privacy breach mentioned in any complaint

name: Account takeover words
conditions: keywords_any=hacked|someone logged into|someone logged in to|someone changed my password|unknown device|suspicious login
description: Account takeover mentioned in any complaint

name: Device acting on its own
conditions: keywords_any=door unlocked by itself|unlocked by itself|lock opened by itself|camera turned on by itself|voice through the camera|someone talking through|intruder|break-in|burglary
description: Physical security of the home at risk

name: Unauthorized order
description: Order placed without the customer's consent

name: Regulator complaint
conditions: keywords_any=regulator|consumer protection|ombudsman|trading standards|report you to|data protection authority|file a complaint with

name: Third complaint
description: Customer complaining for the third time

name: Repeat wording
conditions: keywords_any=third time|fourth time|fifth time|complained three times|complained multiple times|again and again
description: Customer says the complaint is repeated even if history is missing

name: Business customer repeat
description: Business customer with an earlier complaint

name: Premium customer repeat
description: LumoraCare+ customer with an earlier complaint

name: Chargeback
conditions: keywords_any=chargeback|charge back|dispute with my bank|disputed the charge|bank dispute|card company|credit card company
description: Customer has disputed or will dispute the payment

name: No heating
conditions: products=Smart Thermostat;keywords_any=no heat|no heating|freezing|too cold|heating stopped|heating not working
description: Thermostat failure leaving home without heat

name: Locked out of home
conditions: keywords_any=locked out of my home|locked out of my house|can't get into my house|cannot get into my house|can't open my door|cannot open my door|stuck outside

name: Serious staff misconduct
description: Threats, harassment or discrimination by staff

name: Theft or property damage
conditions: keywords_any=technician stole|stole|theft|missing after the visit|damaged my wall|damaged my property|property damage|water leak|flooded
description: Property damage or theft during a visit

name: Installation electrical hazard
conditions: categories=INSTALLATION;keywords_any=exposed wire|exposed wires|live wire|tripping the breaker|breaker keeps tripping|sparks

name: Policy exception request
conditions: keywords_any=make an exception|exception|goodwill|outside the return window|bend the rules
description: Customer asks for something outside policy

name: Data rights request
conditions: keywords_any=gdpr|data protection|right to be forgotten|subject access request
